title: First Official Trailer! - Gates of Azura
author: Azutra
selftext:
Hello everyone! 

I have been creating my first game since Auguat last year. At first with very little understanding of what i was doing or how i could get AI to help me in my process. 

I am now at a stage where I feel comfortable to share my official first showcase/trailer for the game. Please share with me your feedback on the video itself, but more importantly the game. 

It is a mobile JRPG game in which you wake up to find yourself in a fantasy world. Making friends and collecting units along the way you need to defeat 12 gods guarding gates to be able to reach the crystal, harness its power and get back home!

This has been a WIP since August 2026. I am happy with the progress looking back at how it started.

Please let me know your thoughts?
